name: Seeking Strahad

narrative.details:
It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, adventurer. I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.

He makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
adventurer? Ah, of course. Our latest prodigy. The real thing can not live up to the legend, I am afraid.

No matter, you have come here to learn, not to hear me make jokes to myself.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
